name: Continuum and Distortion spells consume all Echo Fragments (#5017)
contract: Every spell whose CasterAuraSpell is 804455 (Echo Fragment) reads 'per Echo Fragment consumed' in its own Description[enUS]: Flux Emitter 804435 (Continuum), Singularity Core 804438 (Continuum), Paradox Cannon 806203 (Continuum), Arc Collision 524853 (Distortion) and both Shatter Echo records 572417/804503 (Distortion, both independently acquirable per their own SkillLineAbility rows). AscensionCustomResourceData.h's ResourceCostRules had zero class-22 rows, so nothing ever removed the fragments: the aura only ever expired on its own duration. The new rows use ResourceConsumption::All, matching AscensionCompat.cpp's OnSpellCast handling (player->RemoveAurasDueToSpell(804455) on a class-22 cast in range), so casting any of these spells while Echo Fragment stacks are up must drop the stack count to 0 in the same cast that consumes them. This scenario exercises one Continuum spell (804435, self-target) and one Distortion spell (524853, enemy-target) and resets the fixture between them so each consumption is independently observed. Fails before the fix (stacks unchanged by either cast), passes after.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
Fixture: 3 Echo Fragments before casting Flux Emitter
Flux Emitter (Continuum) consumes all Echo Fragments
Let Flux Emitter's global cooldown pass
Fixture: 3 Echo Fragments before casting Arc Collision
Arc Collision (Distortion) consumes all Echo Fragments
